name: Spyro: Shadow Legacy
subtitle: Native PC port (projShadow)
description: The Nintendo DS adventure running natively on PC: OpenGL 3D, full sound, saving and loading, keyboard and controller support, and resolutions up to 4K. Uses your own copy of the game.

requirements.minimum: Requires a 32-bit processor and operating system
requirements.processor: Dual-core 2.4 GHz with SSE2 (Intel Core 2 Duo E6600 / AMD Athlon 64 X2 6000+)
requirements.graphics: OpenGL 3.0 support (NVIDIA GeForce 8400 GS / ATI Radeon HD 2400 / Intel HD Graphics 2000)
